produkt.sushi-strumpor.title: Sushi Socks
produkt.sushi-strumpor.body_html:
Nobody cheers for laundry detergent. Nobody keeps a gag gift.

The funny present lasts one evening, then lives in a drawer. The practical one gets used, but the wrapping comes off in silence. You don't have to pick: this one is funny tonight and on their feet tomorrow.

Looks like sushi. Is socks.

They think it's real sushi – until they work out what it actually is. They look twice. Then they laugh. When the laughing stops, it's still socks – something you actually need and use.

What you get

  • 5 pairs of socks, rolled like sushi pieces
  • A sushi box that fools the eye – looks like takeaway until you open it
  • Wooden chopsticks included, to complete the illusion
  • One size – fits EU 36–44
  • Free shipping – arrives in 5–10 business days

Last year, the sushi box sold out in November.

30 days to change your mind.

30-day returns. If it doesn't work out, just send it back – no awkward questions.

sida.fraktpolicy.title: Shipping Policy
sida.fraktpolicy.body_html:
SHIPPING 


It takes 1-2 business days for your order to be processed. Our products ship from our overseas warehouse with 5-10 business days of trackable shipping if the item isn't in stock in our Swedish warehouse, which otherwise ships with trackable shipping via PostNord. You'll receive an order confirmation email once your order has been placed.


If your order ships from our overseas warehouse, you may also need to pay a fee upon import. 


 


SHIPPING CONFIRMATION & ORDER TRACKING


You'll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number once your order has shipped. Please check your spam folder in case it ends up there.


If you can't find your email, don't hesitate to reach out to us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se and we'll help you out!


 


Our prices exclude VAT, so customs duties and import fees may apply when the item comes from our warehouse in China. It's the customer's responsibility to pay any such fees.
sida.retur-aterbetalningspolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
sida.retur-aterbetalningspolicy.body_htm:
We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

 To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn, with all tags attached, and in its original packaging. You'll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

 To start a return, you can contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se.

 If your return is accepted, we'll send you instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

 If you have any questions about returns, you can always contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se.

Damages and issues
 Please inspect your order upon receipt and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you received the wrong item, so we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Exceptions / non-returnable items
 Certain types of items cannot be returned, such as perishable goods (for example food, flowers, or plants), custom products (for example special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (for example beauty products). We also do not accept returns of hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please contact us if you have questions or concerns about a particular item.

 Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.

Exchanges
 The fastest way to make sure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.

European Union 14 day cooling off period
 Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is delivered within the EU, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, the item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn, with all tags attached, and in its original packaging. You'll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

Refunds
 We will let you know once we've received and inspected your return, and whether or not the refund was approved. If approved, you'll be automatically refunded to your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process the return so it shows up on your end.
 If more than 15 business days have passed since we approved your return, please contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se
sida.integritetspolicy.title: Privacy Policy
sida.integritetspolicy.body_html:
Last updated: December 1, 2025

Matstrumpor operates this store and website, including all related information, content, features, tools, products, and services, to provide you, our customer, with a personalized shopping experience (the “Services”). Matstrumpor is powered by Shopify, which enables us to provide the Services to you. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information when you visit, use, or make a purchase or other transaction using the Services, or otherwise communicate with us. If there is a conflict between our Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy, this Privacy Policy takes precedence with respect to the collection, processing, and disclosure of your personal information.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By using and accessing any of the Services, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy and understand how your information is collected, used, and disclosed as described in this Privacy Policy.

Personal Information We Collect or Process

When we use the term “personal information,” we mean information that identifies, or reasonably can be linked to, you or another person. Personal information does not include information collected anonymously or that has been de-identified so that it cannot identify or reasonably be linked to you. We may collect or process the following categories of personal information, including inferences drawn from this personal information, depending on how you interact with the Services, where you live, and to the extent permitted or required by applicable law:

  • Contact details including name, address, billing address, shipping address, phone number, and email address.
  • Financial information including credit card numbers, debit card numbers, and financial account numbers, payment card information, financial account information, transaction details, payment method information, payment confirmations, and other payment details.
  • Account information including username, password, security questions, preferences, and settings.
  • Transaction information including the items you view, place in your cart, add to your wishlist, or purchase, return, exchange, or cancel, as well as your past transactions.
  • Communications with us including the information you provide in your communications with us, for example when you submit a customer support request.
  • Device information including information about your device, browser, or network connection, your IP address, and other unique identifiers.
  • Usage information including information about your interaction with the Services, including how and when you interact with or navigate the Services.

Sources of Personal Information

We may collect personal information from the following sources:

  • Directly from you including when you create an account, visit or use the Services, communicate with us, or otherwise provide us with your personal information;
  • Automatically through the Services including from your device when you use our products or services or visit our websites, as well as through the use of cookies and similar technologies;
  • From our service providers including when we engage them to enable certain technology and when they collect or process your personal information on our behalf;
  • From our partners or other third parties.

How We Use Your Personal Information

Depending on how you interact with us or which of our Services you use, we may use personal information for the following purposes:

  • Providing, personalizing, and improving the Services. We use your personal information to provide the Services, including to fulfill our contract with you, process your payments, deliver your orders, remember your preferences and the items you are interested in, send you notifications related to your account, process purchases, returns, exchanges, or other transactions, create, maintain, and otherwise manage your account, arrange for delivery, facilitate returns and exchanges, enable you to post reviews, and create a personalized shopping experience for you, such as by recommending products related to your purchases. This may include using your personal information to better personalize and improve the Services.
  • Marketing and advertising. We use your personal information for marketing and advertising purposes, such as to send you marketing, promotional, and campaign communications by email, text message, or mail, and to show you online advertisements for products or services on the Services or other websites, including based on items you have previously purchased or added to your cart, as well as other activity on the Services.
  • Security and fraud prevention. We use your personal information to verify your account, to provide a secure payment and shopping experience, to detect, investigate, or take action against possible fraudulent, illegal, unsafe, or harmful activity, to protect public safety, and to secure our Services. If you choose to use the Services and register an account, you are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. We strongly recommend that you do not share your username, password, or other access credentials with anyone else.
  • Communicating with you. We use your personal information to provide you with customer support, respond to your questions, provide effective services, and maintain our business relationship with you.
  • Legal reasons. We use your personal information to comply with applicable law or respond to valid legal process, including requests from law enforcement authorities or government agencies, to investigate or participate in civil proceedings, potential or actual litigation, or other adversarial legal proceedings, and to enforce or investigate potential violations of our terms or policies.

How We Disclose Personal Information

Under certain circumstances, we may disclose your personal information to third parties for legitimate purposes in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Such circumstances may include, among other things:

  • With Shopify, vendors, and other third parties who perform services on our behalf (e.g., IT management, payment processing, data analytics, customer support, cloud storage, fulfillment, and shipping).
  • With business and marketing partners to provide marketing services and advertise to you. For example, we use Shopify to support personalized advertising with third-party services based on your online activity across different merchants and websites. Our business and marketing partners will use your information in accordance with their own privacy notices. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to request that we not share information about you to show you targeted advertising and marketing based on your online activity across different merchants and websites.
  • When you direct us, or otherwise consent to us, disclosing certain information to third parties, such as to ship products to you or through your use of social media widgets or login integrations.
  • With our affiliates or otherwise within our corporate group.
  • In connection with a business transaction such as a merger or bankruptcy, to comply with applicable legal obligations (including responding to subpoenas, search warrants, and similar requests), to enforce applicable terms of service or policies, and to protect or defend the Services, our rights, and the rights of our users or others.

Relationship with Shopify

The Services are provided by Shopify, which collects and processes personal information about your access to and use of the Services in order to provide and improve the Services for you. Information you provide to the Services will be transferred to and shared with Shopify, as well as third parties, who may be located in countries other than the country where you live, in order to provide and improve the Services for you. In addition, to protect, develop, and improve our business, we also use certain enhanced features from Shopify that include data and information obtained from your interactions with our store, other merchants, and Shopify. To provide these enhanced features, Shopify may use personal information collected about your interactions with our store, other merchants, and Shopify. Under these circumstances, Shopify is responsible for the processing of your personal information, including responding to your requests to exercise your rights regarding the use of your personal information for these purposes. For more information about how Shopify uses your personal information and the rights you have, you may visit Shopify's Consumer Privacy Policy. Depending on where you live, you may be able to exercise certain rights regarding your personal information here. Link to Shopify's Privacy Portal.

Third-Party Websites and Links

The Services may provide links to websites or other online platforms operated by third parties. If you follow links to websites that are not affiliated with or controlled by us, you should review their privacy and security policies and other rules and terms. We do not guarantee and are not responsible for the privacy or security of such websites, including the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of the information found on those websites. Information you provide in public or semi-public places, including information you share on third-party social networking platforms, may also be visible to other users of the Services and/or users of those third-party platforms, without restriction as to its use by us or by third parties. Our inclusion of such links does not, in itself, imply any endorsement of the content on such platforms or of their owners or operators, except as stated on the Services.

Children's Data

The Services are not intended for use by children, and we do not knowingly collect any personal information about children under the age of majority in your jurisdiction. If you are a parent or guardian of a child who has provided their personal information to us, you may contact us using the contact details below to request that it be deleted. As of the effective date of this Privacy Policy, we have no knowledge that we “share” or “sell” (as defined under applicable law) personal information of individuals under 16 years of age.

Security and Retention of Your Information

Please note that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and we cannot guarantee “perfect security.” In addition, information you send to us may be insecure while in transit. We recommend that you do not use insecure channels to send us sensitive or confidential information.

How long we retain your personal information depends on various factors, such as whether we need the information to maintain your account, provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce other applicable agreements and policies.

Your Rights and Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the rights listed below in relation to your personal information. However, these rights are not absolute, may apply only in certain circumstances, and in some cases we may decline your request in accordance with the law.

  • Right to access/know. You may have the right to request access to personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to delete. You may have the right to request that we delete personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to correct. You may have the right to request that we correct inaccurate personal information we hold about you.
  • Right to portability. You may have the right to receive a copy of the personal information we hold about you and to request that we transfer it to a third party, under certain circumstances and with certain exceptions.
  • Manage communication preferences. We may send you marketing emails, and you can choose to stop receiving them at any time by using the unsubscribe option shown in our emails to you. If you unsubscribe, we may still send you non-promotional emails, such as those about your account or orders you have placed.

If you are a resident of the United Kingdom or the European Economic Area, and subject to the exceptions and limitations under local law, you may exercise the following rights in addition to the rights listed above:

  • Objection to processing and restriction of processing: You may have the right to request that we stop or restrict our processing of personal information for certain purposes.
  • Withdrawal of consent: Where we rely on your consent to process your personal information, you have the right to withdraw that consent. If you withdraw your consent, this will not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out with your consent before it was withdrawn.

You may exercise any of these rights where indicated on the Services or by contacting us using the contact details below. For more information about how Shopify uses your personal information and the rights you have, including rights related to data processed by Shopify, you may visit https://privacy.shopify.com/en.

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights. We may need to verify your identity before we can process your requests, in accordance with applicable law. In accordance with applicable law, you may designate an authorized agent to submit requests on your behalf to exercise your rights. Before we accept such a request from an agent, we will require the agent to provide proof that you have authorized them to act on your behalf, and we may require you to verify your identity directly with us. We will respond to your request within the time required by applicable law.

Complaints

If you have complaints about how we process your personal information, please contact us using the contact details below. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to appeal our decision by contacting us using the contact details below or by filing a complaint with your local data protection authority. For EEA countries, you can find a list of the relevant data protection supervisory authorities here.

International Transfers

Please note that we may transfer, store, and process your personal information outside the country where you live.

If we transfer your personal information outside the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we will use recognized transfer mechanisms such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent agreement issued by the relevant competent authority in the United Kingdom, as applicable, unless the data transfer is to a country that has been found to offer an adequate level of protection.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on this website, update the “Last updated” date, and provide notice as required by applicable law.

Contact

If you have any questions about our privacy practices or this Privacy Policy, or if you would like to exercise any of your rights, please email us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se, or contact us at Stenkolsgatan 1B, 417 07 Göteborg, Sweden. In accordance with applicable data protection laws, we are the data controller of your personal information.
sida.om-oss.title: About us
sida.om-oss.body_html:
Socks that look like food

We sell socks that look like sushi, pizza, burgers, and donuts – packaged so the box looks like real food. The gift that makes the recipient laugh out loud when they open the box – and then actually gets worn.

Let's be honest: everyone runs low on socks, and mismatched socks are just a fact of life. But you'll never mix these up.

What we promise

  • Delivered in gift packaging – ready to give right away
  • Free shipping
  • 30-day returns – not happy? Reach out and we'll sort it out, no hassle

Contact

Have a question? Email kundsupport@matstrumpor.se and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

Matstrumpor.se is operated by STONEBITE ECOM AB, company registration no. 559576-2401.
sida.data-sharing-opt-out.title: Your privacy choices
sida.data-sharing-opt-out.body_html:
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing personal information for targeted advertising based on your interactions across different websites may be considered a "sale", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are located, we will treat this as a request to opt out of any activity that may be considered a "sale" or "sharing" of personal information, or other use that may be considered targeted advertising, for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

{% endif %}

You may exercise any of these rights where indicated in the Services or by contacting us using the contact details below. For more information about how Shopify uses your personal information and what rights you have, including rights related to data processed by Shopify, you can visit https://privacy.shopify.com/en.

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights. We may need to verify your identity before we can process your requests, in accordance with applicable law. In accordance with applicable laws, you may designate an authorized agent to request the exercise of your rights on your behalf. Before we accept such a request from an agent, we will require the agent to provide proof that you have authorized them to act on your behalf, and we may ask you to verify your identity directly with us. We will respond to your request within the time required under applicable law.

Complaints

If you have complaints about how we process your personal information, please contact us using the contact details below. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to appeal our decision by contacting us using the contact details below or by lodging a complaint with your local data protection authority.{% if selling_to_europe %} For EEA countries, you can find a list of responsible data protection authorities here.{% endif %}

International Transfers

Please note that we may transfer, store, and process your personal information outside the country where you live.

If we transfer your personal information outside the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we will use recognized transfer mechanisms such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent agreement issued by the relevant competent authority in the United Kingdom, as applicable, unless the data transfer is to a country that has been found to offer an adequate level of protection.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on this website, update the “Last updated” date, and provide notice as required by applicable law.

Contact

policy.REFUND_POLICY.body:
We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.

 To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn, with all tags attached, and in its original packaging. You'll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

 To start a return, you can contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se.

 If your return is accepted, we'll send you a return shipping label as well as instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back to us without first requesting a return will not be accepted.

 If you have any questions about returns, you can always contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se.

Damages and issues
 Please inspect your order upon receipt and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you received the wrong item, so we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

Exceptions / non-returnable items
 Certain types of items cannot be returned, such as perishable goods (for example food, flowers, or plants), custom products (for example special orders or personalized items), and personal care goods (for example beauty products). We also do not accept returns of hazardous materials, flammable liquids, or gases. Please contact us if you have questions or concerns about a particular item.

 Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards.

Exchanges
 The fastest way to make sure you get what you want is to return the item you have, and once the return is accepted, make a separate purchase for the new item.

European Union 14 day cooling off period
 Notwithstanding the above, if the merchandise is delivered within the EU, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason and without a justification. As above, the item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn, with all tags attached, and in its original packaging. You'll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.

Refunds
 We will let you know once we've received and inspected your return, and whether or not the refund was approved. If approved, you'll be automatically refunded to your original payment method within 10 business days. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process the return so it shows up on your end.
 If more than 15 business days have passed since we approved your return, please contact us at kundsupport@matstrumpor.se
policy.TERMS_OF_SERVICE.body:
Terms of Service – Matstrumpor.se

Last updated: January 23, 2026

These Terms of Service apply when you visit or shop on our website. By using the website or making a purchase, you agree to the terms below.

1. General

Matstrumpor.se sells its products online to consumers. To shop with us, you must be at least 18 years old or have a parent's or guardian's consent.

We reserve the right to update or change these terms at any time. The version that applies is the one published on the website at the time of purchase.

2. Orders and Agreement

When you complete an order, an order confirmation is sent to the email address you provided. This confirmation means a binding agreement has been made between you and Matstrumpor.se.

We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order in the event of suspected fraud, incorrect information, or stock errors.

3. Prices and Payment

All prices are in the currency shown at checkout.

Payment is made using the payment options offered at checkout. Matstrumpor.se is not responsible for any fees that may be charged by third-party payment providers.

4. Delivery

Delivery time is shown at the time of purchase. Any delays will be communicated by email. Matstrumpor.se is not responsible for delays caused by the carrier or force majeure.

Risk of loss for the item transfers to you once you've received the delivery.

5. Right of Withdrawal and Returns

Under the Swedish Distance Contracts Act, you have the right to cancel your purchase within 14 days of receiving the item.  We also offer 30-day returns (see policy).

To exercise the right of withdrawal, the product must be returned in essentially unchanged condition. The customer is responsible for return shipping unless otherwise stated.

For returns or questions about the right of withdrawal, contact us at:
📧 kundsupport@matstrumpor.se

6. Complaints

If an item is faulty or damaged on delivery, you have the right to file a complaint under the Swedish Consumer Sales Act. Contact customer support as soon as possible and include a description and photo if possible.

7. Limitation of Liability

Matstrumpor.se is not liable for indirect damages that may arise from use of the website or the products, unless otherwise required by mandatory law.

8. Intellectual Property Rights

All content on this website (text, images, graphics, logos, etc.) belongs to Matstrumpor.se or its licensors and may not be used without written permission.

9. Personal Data

We process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection legislation (GDPR). Read more in our privacy policy.

10. Disputes and Governing Law

Swedish law applies to these terms. Disputes shall first be resolved amicably, and secondly through the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN) or the Swedish general courts.

11. Contact

If you have questions about these terms or your order, you're always welcome to contact us:

📧 kundsupport@matstrumpor.se
